featured_reviews.review_text:
I moved into Omkar Ananta recently after living in Raheja for 4 years and having seen Omkars Alta monte property thought Omkar Ananta would be of the same caliber.. but I am very disappointed with everything in this society be it the security, admin, management everything is just a let down..

Starting with the cleanliness in the society no matter how many pest controls they do thr are always small cockroaches and other insects crawling arnd. Then coming to the noise arnd the society - it's always noisy cos it's in middle of the market and next to the slum, some one is always having loud speakers on in the area either shouting on the mike for no reason or playing music.. no peace at all!!

Let's talk abt the security in the building - they have the so called my gate app which is jus for namesake and is not monitored properly at all.. jus in the matter of the 1st 2 months of moving into the society thr has been a break-in/theft in my house something which i have never faced after living in Mumbai for so many years but for the 1st time in this society I had to face it, which means someone can jus enter the building not be noticed and an entry had not been done of that person opened the door with a key which god knows how they achieved as I jus moved in and literally hadnt even given the address or key to ne one I know other than one or 2 family members, after all this the owner and management only questioned me that I made a mistake and washed their hands off the entire incident while not showing any concern on my safety whatsoever!! They only said go file an FIR and the police did a minor investigation as thr r no cameras on each floor and cameras are ONLY till the lift area so they had to close the case.. now finally after 25 days the society gives me the lift footage for that week when the incident happened and asked me to go thru it!! I have never seen such poor handling of such a big incident whr no one shows any concern or any kindness towards a single girl staying in the society. Moving in to this society has jus been such a let down for the 50k rent u pay u dont even get the basics.. the society is jus filled with students who r weirdos roaming arnd in the society, thrs jus no class in the crowd living in this place.. I am very sorry to say that I moved into an Omkar builder property with high hopes but it's  all jus a big let down!! I have lived in smaller societys than this and never faced such issues.. neway all I want to say is it is really not worth the 50k rent u pay here!!

featured_reviews.name: samreen khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in search for an Airbnb which would allow visitors and could let us organise a get together with friends,and luckily I found this apartment in Omkar Signet-I would recommend it if anyone looking for Airbnb in an around Malad East.
The property is located at the western express highway.

Coming to the apartment it’s a 2bhk furnished apartment with basic amenities like sofa and dinning table and tv and wifi in the living room
Both the rooms have a queen size bed,wardrobes and attached washroom.
The kitchen just includes a refrigerator and few utensils

The caretaker-Gulshan was cooperative and cleaned the apartment very well and did help us getting things if anything required.

Kanishk helped us sort out the apartment for us.

Just few feedback’s-
AC is a must in the living room if everyone wants to spend time in the living room dining and watching tv,monsoon it’s fine but during summer it’s not bearable.

Please inform the guards that any parcels through Zomato,swiggy or Blinkit should be pre approved it gets too much to go down from the 26th floor every now and then to receive parcels

Toiletries like tooth paste and tissue rolls are needed

The kitchen should have a microwave for basic heating.

The wifi connectivity should be in the rooms as well.

Rest the apartment is go to and it’s safe.
